title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 014
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute flag and building variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Rectangular flag panel with a forked notch on a vertical line pole
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple pole flag with a rectangular body and a forked tail notch.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the triangular or wavy flags when the body should stay rectangular.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows the broadest flag panel with a clear cutout notch at the trailing edge.

items.depicts_observation: Angled flag panel on a vertical line pole with a diagonal lower edge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a stiffer banner shape with straight edges and a diagonal bottom.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the notch or pennant flags when the body is a four sided angled panel.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot forms a slanted four sided panel instead of a notched or wavy flag cloth.

items.depicts_observation: Triangular flag panel with a vertical line pole at the left
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple triangular pennant instead of a rectangular flag body.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for wider flags when the pointed triangle shape is the main cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only selected flag reduced to a clean triangular pennant.

items.depicts_observation: Wavy flag outline with a vertical line pole at the left
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a soft cloth like flag shape rather than a stiff banner panel.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the straight edged flags when the wavy cloth outline should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot differs from the other flags by using a visibly wavy cloth contour.

items.depicts_observation: Tall slanted center tower with short side panels on both sides above a base
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a modern three tower building with a tall central wedge.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the flatter buildings when the central slanted tower and two side towers matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a tall center wedge flanked by two shorter towers on the same base.
